about: Greybox TTK check (dev plan G-4, tools/greybox/report.js). targets: reference squads every armed squad duels; max_turns: duel length. ranges: the best median TTK (or, with measure pin, the best median time until the target is pinned) a squad of this role should reach against targets of this kind, in own turns (design values); squads outside are flagged — fix the data or record why. exceptions: squads outside the ranges for a recorded reason (G-5); the report shows them as accepted.
